full_judgment: 2. In Civil Petition No. 318 of 2000 the defendant No. 1, Obeda Khatun and six others are the petitioners herein whereas in Civil Petition No. 319 of 2000 Md Rejaul Hoque Fakir is another sole defendant petitioner. Most Jaheda Khatun is the plaintiff-respondent No. 1 in both the petitions. Since common facts and an identical question of law are involved between the said parties in respect of the selfsame property both the petitions have been heard together and this single judgment will govern both of them. The relevant facts in Civil Petition No. 318 of 2000 are that on 24-9-1984 the said plaintiff-respondent No. 1 Most. Jaheda Khatun instituted Title Suit No. 249 against the petitioners and proforma defendant-respondent No. 2 Abdus Sobhan in the court of the then First Court, Bogra for declaration of Title and recovery of the suit premises stating, inter alia, that the suit property was purchased by Chaturbhuj Kautia and others from the original owner Kajem Uddin Tarafdar and his sons Ekram and Ebadat by registered sale deed, that while Chaturbhuj Kautia was in possession of suit land, the plaintiff-respondent No. 1 took settlement of the land from the aforesaid purchaser Chaturbhuj Kautia by a registered patta dated 19-11-1955 on payment of Taka 2950 as Najrana and took possession thereof; that the MRR Khatian in respect of the suit land has been published in the name of the respondent No. 1; that thereafter, she constructed some shops on the suit land; that the predecessor of petitioner Nos. 1-6 took lease of shop No. 3 on monthly rent by executing a lease agreement for a period of 5 (five) years; that the petitioner's said predecessor defaulted in payment of the rent and also sub-let a portion of the suit premises in favour of petitioner No. 7 in violation of the lease agreement and for which the respondent No. 1 instituted a SCC suit against the predecessor of the petitioner Nos. 1-6 and petitioner No. 7; that since the SCC suit involved a complicated question of title same was withdrawn and hence the instant suit was filed.
